method: walk-forward one-shot forecasts from SSB 03024 weekly prices; forecast issued at week t with t's seasonal phase (as_of), evaluated at t+h only when the week gap is exactly h weeks; seasonal climatology computed from pre-window years only (<2020); biological inputs held at neutral defaults (price-only path); each horizon also scores a horizon-matched carry-forward baseline on the same points with a Diebold-Mariano test; synthetic (demo/seed) history rows are refused, never merged; produced by scripts/backtest_price_ml.py; this evaluates the price-only configuration — the live outlook also applies lice and supply signals, which this score does not cover
notes: Walk-forward, price-only path (biological inputs neutral). Headline 4w: MAPE 9.05% vs horizon-matched carry-forward 9.44% on the same 88 points; Diebold-Mariano p=0.0031 (model lower loss). coverage_pct is the engine's own 80% band, not re-calibrated here. Demo/seed history rows are refused, so the 2026-10-12 numbers are superseded.
source: SSB table 03024 weekly export prices (real rows only: 52 synthetic rows refused, 353 rows used)
